item.title: ‘Gone in a blink’: Nepal floods sweep away Indian workers who built hotels
item.description: The migrants were at work, building homes and hotels, when the floods hit, sweeping three of them away.

item.title: Enrique hails Dembele, praises Toure after PSG’s win over Bratislava
item.description: PSG coach hails 'marvellous' Dembele after the French forward scored two goals in PSG's 6–1 win over Toure's side.

item.title: Russian attacks kill 7 in Ukraine as Kyiv targets gas plants deep in Arctic
item.description: Ukraine launches one of its deepest strikes to date, targeting natural gas plants in Russia's Arctic region.

item.title: Israeli attacks kill at least four Palestinians in northern Gaza
item.description: Israeli attacks on the occupied Palestinian territory continue despite a 'ceasefire' brokered in October.

item.title: Japan baseball great and atomic bomb survivor Isao Harimoto dies aged 86
item.description: Harimoto, whose record 3,085 career hits still stands, was inducted into the Japanese Baseball Hall of Fame in 1990.

item.title: Europe’s far right: Putin’s best friend?
item.description: Its gains threaten to deepen Europe’s divisions over Ukraine and Russia.

item.title: Zverev defeats Van de Zandschulp in straight sets to enter US Open semis
item.description: The German, who faces Russia’s Karen Khachanov, is the only Grand Slam winner left standing in the men's draw.

item.title: Anthropic discloses 4th AI hacking incident as researcher quits over safety
item.description: AI firm says Claude Opus 4.6 hacked external systems during testing as concerns mount over security breaches.

item.title: Fighting escalates in Yemen; Houthi attacks trigger alerts in Saudi Arabia
item.description: Yemen's government accuses Houthis of killing three children as rebels claim Saudi forces launched 54 air raids in 12 hours.

item.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russian Caspian Sea port in Dagestan
item.description: Fires and explosions were seen in Russia’s Dagestan after a Ukrainian drone attack.

item.title: Trump: Every American gets $5,000 if Republicans win House & Senate
item.description: Donald Trump promised a $5,000 ‘dividend’ to every adult US citizen.

item.title: Five dead, dozens missing in Philippines ferry fire
item.description: Coastguard says the ferry had 134 listed passengers and crew when it sank off the coast of Palawan.

item.title: Netanyahu to sue Haaretz over claims UAE warned him before October 7 attack
item.description: Israeli prime minister denies claim that UAE president warned him of Hamas plans before the 2023 attacks.

item.title: Why is Iran bombing Jordan’s Al-Azraq base?
item.description: Iran has increased its targeting of Jordan’s Muwaffaq Salti Air Base near Al-Azraq in recent weeks.

item.title: Trump vows to be at centre of US midterms: Republican convention takeaways
item.description: Trump says, 'Pretend I’m on the ballot,' as he rallies Republicans ahead of challenging midterm elections.

item.title: Thousands protest in Ljubljana as Slovenia opens Israel’s first embassy
item.description: Nationalist Prime Minister Janez Jansa resets ties with Israel, sparking protests and an impeachment bid.

item.title: Several dead, dozens missing after ferry fire in Philippines tourist spot
item.description: Video from the Philippine Coast Guard shows a ferry engulfed in flames near Palawan.

item.title: Apple unveils first-ever foldable iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple has unveiled the iPhone Duo, its first foldable, passport-shaped smartphone, with a 7.6-inch display.

item.title: Tunisian flotilla activists remain jailed as hunger striker worsens
item.description: The four have been held since March in a financial investigation linked to organisers of the Global Sumud Flotilla.

item.title: Pro-Israel Democrat John Fetterman makes video appearance at GOP convention
item.description: Pennsylvania senator who has clashed with party over Israel support says he will reject 'the extremes and socialism'.

item.title: Trump gave aide Natalie Harp a $45,000 holiday cash gift, disclosure shows
item.description: Federal employees are generally barred from receiving compensation beyond their government salaries.

item.title: Spain’s spy agency warned of mass crossings into Ceuta before border crisis
item.description: Declassified documents show Madrid and Morocco were warned of plans by migrants to breach the Ceuta border.

item.title: US states sue Trump over weakening of endangered species protections
item.description: Attorneys general from 20 states and Washington, DC, say the US government illegally rolled back landmark protections.

item.title: Republicans divided over Trump’s economy as RNC begins
item.description: Republican strategist Adolfo Franco and GOP adviser Rina Shah clash over Trump’s handling of the economy.

item.title: Trump administration proposes excluding certain immigrants from US census
item.description: The proposal aims to exclude some legal and undocumented immigrants from the count used to determine US House seats.
